response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, versatile senior/staff engineer (15+ years) with strong TypeScript/Node.js depth, distributed systems and low-latency work, DevOps/CI maturity, and demonstrable teaching/mentoring through workshops and courses — all of which map well to the staff-level engineering and mentorship aspects of the role. However, the core GenAI requirement is only partially met: relevant AI work is limited to roughly one year at re:cinq (MCP code generators and agentic tooling), far short of the 8+ years of production AI solutions requested. The resume shows no Python, no vector databases or RAG architectures, no LLM evaluation/observability pipelines, no multi-agent frameworks (LangGraph/CrewAI), and only light cloud exposure (AWS CDK). Worth a screening call to probe the depth of the recent MCP/agentic work and cloud/data-pipeline experience, but he is not an obvious fit for a staff-level GenAI forward-deployed role as written.
strengths: 15+ years shipping production software across web, backend, mobile and embedded; strong TypeScript/Node.js
Hands-on with MCP servers and agentic workflow tooling — directly matches a listed key technology
Proven mentoring and public technical communication (workshops, courses, conference talks) suiting a customer-facing staff role
concerns: Only ~1 year of AI-related work vs. the 8+ years of production AI solutions required
No evidence of Python, vector databases, RAG, LLM evaluation/optimization, or multi-agent frameworks
Limited cloud-platform and large-scale data-pipeline experience (AWS CDK only; no GCP/Azure, no structured/unstructured pipeline work)

key_factors.factor: Deep senior engineering breadth and TypeScript expertise
